text: The selflessness of phenomena is realized through the very conceptualized self by which the naive imagine the intrinsic nature of phenomena, such as the grasper and the grasped, and not through an ineffable self, which is the domain of the Buddhas. Similarly, since the selflessness of "consciousness-only" is realized through a self conceptualized as distinct from consciousness, the realization of the selflessness of all phenomena is achieved by establishing consciousness-only, and not by denying its existence.
